title: 6 security settings every GitHub maintainer should enable this week
GitHub Models is being fully retired on July 30, 2026
summary: In June, we announced that we are retiring GitHub Models and closed it to new customers.[^c-b8d27a833f]

title: Copilot CLI auto model selection routes based on task
summary: GitHub Copilot auto model selection now routes to the best model for your task in Copilot CLI, using utilization and model health metrics for a high quality, reliable, and token-efficient experience.[^c-d93139508a]

title: Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are generally available
summary: Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are now generally available.[^c-cd3044f794] Agents can now drive a real browser, navigate live web apps, and feed what they find back into the chat.[^c-f80fc04da1] Browser tools are on by default with general availability, shaped by feedback from preview users.[^c-08c8744356]

title: Set AI credit session limits in Copilot CLI and SDK
summary: You can now set AI credit session limits in Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot SDK to cap the amount an agent spends in a session.[^c-38a3e885c4]

title: Copilot vision is generally available
summary: Copilot vision is now generally available.[^c-fb25dd4377] You can attach images and PDFs directly to your chat prompts so Copilot can reason about what it sees alongside your code.[^c-733a5506a2]

title: New C++ language server config skill for Copilot CLI
summary: The Microsoft C++ Language Server is now available as a plugin on the Copilot Plugins marketplace.[^c-1a6648838d]

title: Secret scanning public monitoring for enterprises
summary: GitHub is committed to empowering the developer community by helping organizations recognize and address the risks of secret leaks wherever they happen.[^c-c84034f092]

title: Secret scanning adds validators for Asana, IBM, and MessageBird
summary: Secret scanning now runs validity checks on Asana, IBM, and MessageBird secrets so you can tell whether a leaked credential is still active.[^c-66648c1d69]

title: Enterprise managed-settings.json is generally available
summary: GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers can configure AI standards through a managed-settings.json file maintained in a .github-private repository in a selected organization.[^c-95b36671ac]

title: Enterprises can default to auto model selection
summary: Enterprise administrators can now set model to auto in the enterprise managed-settings.json to make Copilot auto model selection the default for new conversations.[^c-b344bee96e] Add auto to .github-private/.github/copilot/managed-settings.json in your source organization for enterprise governance so new conversations start with Copilot auto model selection by default.[^c-ef60fd8e29] Users can still switch to a different model on a per-conversation basis.[^c-ab8d08e4c8]

title: Can agents be proud of their work?
Agents window (Preview)
summary: The Agents window is a dedicated companion window optimized for exploring, iterating on, and reviewing agent sessions across projects and machines.[^c-681dff6ad2]

title: Troubleshoot agent behavior with /troubleshoot
summary: The troubleshoot skill, invoked with the /troubleshoot command, helps diagnose chat issues by analyzing chat session logs and surfacing insights into the agent's behavior.[^c-763f9a331a] Use it to investigate why custom instructions are ignored or why responses are slow.[^c-0786ae4894] In this release, you can use /troubleshoot to diagnose agent host sessions, including local and remote sessions.[^c-2a44a227ee]

title: Subagent credits
summary: When an agent delegates work to a subagent, it can be difficult to know the cost of the delegated work.[^c-eaa0ed86fd] To make this more transparent, you can now hover over a subagent section in the chat response to see the AI credits used by that subagent.[^c-c5370bebdc]

title: Sandboxing for terminal commands on macOS and Linux
summary: Approving every agent-invoked terminal command quickly becomes tedious.[^c-5de4bd60d3] Starting with this release, we're rolling out sandboxing for terminal commands on macOS and Linux: commands run with network access blocked and filesystem access restricted, letting the agent work with fewer prompts.[^c-6d18c3c0ac] The agent only asks for approval when a command needs to elevate and run outside the sandbox.[^c-ba0bf20bcf]

title: Deprecation of the built-in Ollama provider
summary: Model providers can contribute models for the VS Code chat experience via an extension.[^c-780fc6b4ed] By using an extension, providers can give you faster support for new models and capabilities than a built-in provider could offer.[^c-8ad420abc8]

title: Camera, location, devices, and more
summary: The integrated browser now supports per-site permissions.[^c-c98b724d37]

title: How GitHub used secret scanning to reach inbox zero
summary: GitHub had 20,000+ secret scanning alerts across 15,000 repositories.[^c-2b9cfa456f]

title: Cost centers now support AI credit pools
summary: You can now cap how much of your enterprise’s monthly included AI credits a cost center can use.[^c-66dd715aa4]

title: Issue fields are now generally available
summary: Issue fields are now generally available for all GitHub organizations on Free, Team, Enterprise, and GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency plans and will ship in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23.[^c-4f8cd95b29] Issue fields bring structured, typed metadata to issues, making it easy to track priority, effort, dates, and custom values consistently across your organization.[^c-b64dc6c841]

title: Copilot agent session streaming is now in public preview
Copilot CLI no longer needs a personal access token in GitHub Actions
Upcoming deprecation of Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash
Improved accuracy and coverage in Copilot usage metrics reports
